notes.title: Heroes of Hellas Origins: Part Two is out now
notes.notes:
Help Hades in his quest to vanquish evil! Form chains of matching tokens and complete various tasks: find hearts and flowers of life, clear dark vines from the realm you are building, unleash lightning and remove obstacles to bring life to this desolate land.

On your adventure you will meet other gods from the Greek pantheon. Recover their lost powers by finding magical artifacts! Use their abilities at a time of need to shuffle the chips, or destroy firestones and monoliths. The fate of Hellas is in your hands!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11774005/b00f9cc31ee2912c90c520bb8e9783702f310186.png[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Challenge yourself with over 100 match-three puzzle levels
[*]Enjoy a story where the gods look to you for help
[*]Unlock exciting bonuses and achievements
[*]Original soundtracks for download
[*]Downloadable wallpapers
[*]7 concept art paintings
[*]Descriptions of heroes’ helpers
[*]Descriptions of creatures appearing in the world of Hades
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2086820/Heroes_of_Hellas_Origins_Part_Two/

notes.title: The Snow Fable: Mystery of the Flame is out now
notes.notes:
Embark on a match-three adventure of breathtaking magic and boundless imagination! A girl embarks on a quest to save her fiery friend. But with each step forward, she draws closer to an encounter with a dark force she could not have conceived!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11774005/f2346a2ae1c0d444bcf64ee12478f7c25e4558b4.jpg[/img]

[b]Features:[/b][list]
[*] 72 captivating Adventure levels
[*] Challenging Infinity mode
[*] 4 bonus trials with 8 levels each
[*] Achievements to earn
[*] Downloadable original soundtrack
[*] Dazzling desktop wallpapers
[*] Step-by-step tutorial[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2019650/The_Snow_Fable_Mystery_of_the_Flame/
